name: @opencraw/studio-desktop
description: OpenCraw Studio as a desktop app: an Electron window around the local Studio server.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --sourcemap && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');for(const[i,g,o,w]of[['src/desktop-bridge','preload.cjs','dist',0]])for(const f of fs.globSync(g,{cwd:i})){const s=p.join(i,f),d=p.join(o,f);if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){if(w)fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true})}else{fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}}"
scripts.e2e: vite build -c ../studio-ui/vite.config.mts && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && jest --config jest.e2e.config.cts --forceExit
